_meta.summary: Fires when any battery-class sensor reports below 15%.
_meta.depends_on: The metric ha.sensor.value (FROZEN METRIC CONTRACT) is emitted by the parallel sidecar/metrics agent. apply_alerts.py flags the rule 'applied, pending data' if the metric is not yet in signoz_metrics, so it is safe to apply before the sidecar is live. VERIFIED LIVE: the sidecar is emitting ha.sensor.value{device_class=battery,entity_id=sensor.garage_door_battery} and this rule fired (state=firing) within ~4 min of the battery being set to 0.
_meta.fire_on_demand: Drop the seeded battery helper below the threshold: POST /api/services/input_number/set_value {"entity_id":"input_number.garage_battery","value":10}. The sidecar mirrors input_number.garage_battery -> sensor.garage_door_battery -> ha.sensor.value{device_class=battery}=10 < 15 -> fires. Restore with value 55 (or script.restore_garage_battery). (See FIRE-ON-DEMAND.md.)
_meta.op_encoding: op '2' = below; matchType '1' = at least once; target 15 => fire when any battery reading < 15%.

annotations.description: A battery-class sensor (ha.sensor.value, device_class=battery) is reporting below 15%. In the seeded house the garage door sensor battery backs the dead-battery -> dead-automation story: once it reaches 0 the garage_check health automation stops running (see the 'Automation gone quiet' rule).
